Q2: Bis(2-chloroethoxy)methane is not currently identified on any specific "Lists of Concern" or "Lists of Low Hazard".
Q3: Bis(2-chloroethoxy)methane appears to be reasonably well-characterized; its molecular formula is precisely defined, and it is classified as a "Small Molecule" rather than an incompletely defined substance or UVCB.
